name: tongxing-website
description: Root package for Tongxing Waldorf Website

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix functions
scripts.build:fast: npm run build:fast --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix functions
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy iphone-test --expires 7d
scripts.deploy:preview:fast: npm run build:preview --prefix frontend && firebase hosting:channel:deploy iphone-test --expires 7d
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix functions
